title: Stride: Scale-Aware Multi-Agent Evolutionary Refinement for Infographic Generation
title_zh: Stride：面向信息图生成的尺度感知多智能体进化式优化

paragraphs.en: Stride 是一个针对信息图生成的多智能体进化式优化框架，能够有效应对尺度不匹配问题，提升生成质量。 Infographic generation challenges text-to-image models because a single image must satisfy numerous visual, textual, and semantic constraints. Iterative agentic refinement with a multimodal verifier is a natural remedy, but existing methods face a scale mismatch: local edits cannot correct global composition errors, while full regeneration may destroy already-correct regions. We introduce Stride, a constraint-grounded multi-agent framework that treats refinement over any frozen generator as a history-aware evolution strategy. Stride separates constraint evaluation - whether each requirement is satisfied - from visual grounding - where and how it is violated. It then routes global revisions to a composer subagent and local corrections to a retoucher subagent. Each subagent conducts internal planning and generates multiple candidates, while Stride accepts a candidate only when it improves the verifier score, reducing regression across iterations. Because stochastic generators and imperfect verifiers make any single step unreliable, it is this combination of scale-aware routing, per-step redundancy, and monotonic acceptance that yields stable improvement across iterations. With fully open-weight generator-verifier systems, Stride outperforms proprietary systems including Nano-Banana-2.0 and Seedream-5.0-Pro on BizGenEval, matches GPT-Image-2.0 and surpasses Seedream-5.0-Pro on IGenBench, and achieves a new state-of-the-art score on WISE, while substantially outperforming existing agentic methods across all evaluated benchmarks.
paragraphs.zh: Stride 是一个面向信息图生成的多智能体进化式优化框架，能够有效应对尺度不匹配问题，提升生成质量。信息图生成对文本到图像模型构成挑战，因为单张图像必须满足众多视觉、文本和语义约束。 通过多模态验证器进行迭代智能体精修是一种自然的解决方案，但现有方法面临尺度不匹配的问题：局部编辑无法修正全局构图错误，而完全重新生成则可能破坏已正确的区域。 我们提出 Stride，一个基于约束的多智能体框架，它将任何固定生成器的精修过程视为一种具有历史感知的进化策略。 Stride 将约束评估——即各项要求是否得到满足——与视觉定位——即约束在何处以及如何被违反——分离开来。 随后，它会将全局修订任务分配给一个构图子智能体，而局部修正则分配给一个修饰子智能体。 每个子智能体都会进行内部规划并生成多个候选结果，而 Stride 仅当候选结果能提升验证器得分时才会接受，从而减少迭代过程中的性能倒退。 由于随机生成器和不完美的验证器使得任何单步操作都不可靠，正是这种结合尺度感知路由、每步冗余和单调接受的机制，才实现了跨迭代的稳定改进。 在完全开放权重的生成器-验证器系统中，Stride 在 BizGenEval 上的表现优于 Nano-Banana-2.0 和 Seedream-5.0-Pro 等专有系统，与 GPT-Image-2.0 相当并在 IGenBench 上超越 Seedream-5.0-Pro，同时在 WISE 上取得了新的最优得分，并且在所有评估基准中显著优于现有的智能体方法。
